client/src/lib/access-operations.ts.name: Access test examples
client/src/lib/access-operations.ts.description: Offers a short list of everyday operations to try when checking who is allowed to do what.

client/src/lib/access-trace.ts.name: Access explanations
client/src/lib/access-trace.ts.description: Turns the server's technical access decisions into sentences naming roles, organizations and permissions.

client/src/lib/agent-run-navigation.ts.name: Agent run return path
client/src/lib/agent-run-navigation.ts.description: Remembers where someone came from so closing an agent run returns them to the right place.

client/src/lib/api-client.ts.name: Server connection
client/src/lib/api-client.ts.description: The one way the screens talk to the main server, handling sign-in, safety checks and clear failures.

client/src/lib/api-error.ts.name: Error messages
client/src/lib/api-error.ts.description: Turns a failed request into a plain message people can read, including when too many requests were made.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform.d.ts.name: App building tools
client/src/lib/app-code-platform.d.ts.description: Catalogue of the ready-made pieces an app builder may use, from fetching data to running a workflow.

client/src/lib/app-code-runtime.ts.name: App code runner
client/src/lib/app-code-runtime.ts.description: Turns an app's code into working screens by handing it the platform's tools and design pieces.

client/src/lib/application-update.ts.name: App update tracking
client/src/lib/application-update.ts.description: Tracks when a newer version of an app is being installed and tells open screens to reload.

client/src/lib/applicationName.ts.name: Product name
client/src/lib/applicationName.ts.description: Supplies the product name to display, using the organization's own branding when it has some.

client/src/lib/auth-token.ts.name: Sign-in passes
client/src/lib/auth-token.ts.description: Keeps the pass proving who is signed in, including embedded sessions and temporary support access.

client/src/lib/authorization.ts.name: Who may do what
client/src/lib/authorization.ts.description: Answers whether the signed-in person may do something in one organization or platform-wide, so screens show only what fits.

client/src/lib/bifrost-runtime.ts.name: Shared app toolbox
client/src/lib/bifrost-runtime.ts.description: Provides the standard tools and building blocks an app can use when it runs inside the platform.

client/src/lib/brand-palette.ts.name: Brand colours
client/src/lib/brand-palette.ts.description: Exposes the organization's brand colours, with a way to check text stays readable on them.

client/src/lib/branding.ts.name: Branding loader
client/src/lib/branding.ts.description: Fetches the organization's branding and applies it as the app starts.

client/src/lib/builtin-roles.ts.name: Built-in roles
client/src/lib/builtin-roles.ts.description: Identifies the roles that ship with the platform and which of their permissions nothing checks yet.

client/src/lib/chat-runtime.ts.name: Chat session handling
client/src/lib/chat-runtime.ts.description: Keeps a conversation with an agent in step as replies stream in, including tool steps and interruptions.

client/src/lib/chat-utils.ts.name: Message identifiers
client/src/lib/chat-utils.ts.description: Creates unique identifiers for chat messages so replies are matched to the right question.

client/src/lib/client-types.ts.name: Screen data shapes
client/src/lib/client-types.ts.description: Defines the shapes of data the screens use but the server does not describe, such as form fields and run listings.

client/src/lib/clipboard.ts.name: Copy to clipboard
client/src/lib/clipboard.ts.description: Copies text to the clipboard reliably, including on less secure network addresses.

client/src/lib/detail-route-loaders.ts.name: Prefetched detail pages
client/src/lib/detail-route-loaders.ts.description: Loads an agent or app's details before its page opens so it appears without a wait.

client/src/lib/esm-react-shim.ts.name: App runtime globals
client/src/lib/esm-react-shim.ts.description: Makes the platform's core building blocks available to apps loaded while the app is running.

client/src/lib/execution-buckets.ts.name: Run outcome counting
client/src/lib/execution-buckets.ts.description: Sorts runs into worked, failed or cancelled and turns the counts into chart data.

client/src/lib/executionLogs.ts.name: Log merging
client/src/lib/executionLogs.ts.description: Combines saved logs with live ones, skipping lines that arrive twice.

client/src/lib/file-filter.ts.name: Workspace file filtering
client/src/lib/file-filter.ts.description: Decides which files are left out of workspace operations, such as build output and secret files.

client/src/lib/form-embed-presentation.t.name: Embedded form appearance
client/src/lib/form-embed-presentation.t.description: Reads the appearance options for a form embedded in another website.

client/src/lib/graph-source.ts.name: Microsoft 365 event health
client/src/lib/graph-source.ts.description: Describes where Microsoft 365 change notifications come from and whether that link is healthy.

client/src/lib/icons.ts.name: Icon lookup
client/src/lib/icons.ts.description: Finds the right icon by name so every screen draws from a consistent set of pictures.

client/src/lib/lazy-with-reload.ts.name: Reload on new version
client/src/lib/lazy-with-reload.ts.description: Loads a screen only when it is needed, and quietly reloads the page when a newer version has gone live.

client/src/lib/matching.ts.name: Automatic matching
client/src/lib/matching.ts.description: Suggests pairings between records from two systems, exact matches first and close matches after.

client/src/lib/model-info.ts.name: Model descriptions
client/src/lib/model-info.ts.description: Summarises one AI model's price, context size and reasoning options in a single line.

client/src/lib/monaco-setup.ts.name: Code editor setup
client/src/lib/monaco-setup.ts.description: Prepares the code editor with colouring, comments and formatting for the languages used here.

client/src/lib/monaco-theme.ts.name: Editor colours
client/src/lib/monaco-theme.ts.description: Colours the code editor to match the current theme and the organization's brand.

client/src/lib/monaco/conflictDecorator..name: Conflict highlighting
client/src/lib/monaco/conflictDecorator..description: Marks conflicting lines in the code editor and offers buttons to keep one side or both.

client/src/lib/monaco/conflictDetector.t.name: Conflict detection
client/src/lib/monaco/conflictDetector.t.description: Finds conflicting sections in a file and can settle each by keeping one side or both.

client/src/lib/monaco/conflictWidgets.ts.name: Conflict action links
client/src/lib/monaco/conflictWidgets.ts.description: Places the keep-this-side and keep-both links directly between conflicting lines.

client/src/lib/motion.ts.name: Animation timing
client/src/lib/motion.ts.description: Converts the design's animation speeds into values motion can use, honouring reduced-motion preferences.

client/src/lib/npm-search.ts.name: Package search
client/src/lib/npm-search.ts.description: Searches the public package catalogue so app builders can add a library by name.

client/src/lib/paginated-query.ts.name: Page request comparison
client/src/lib/paginated-query.ts.description: Tells whether two list requests ask for the same thing so views do not reload needlessly.

client/src/lib/permission-words.ts.name: Permission wording
client/src/lib/permission-words.ts.description: Rewrites technical permission names into the phrases people read, such as Read and Write Users.

client/src/lib/platform-modules.ts.name: Shared module list
client/src/lib/platform-modules.ts.description: Lists the platform pieces an app loaded at runtime is allowed to draw on.
